headline: Public Relations Officer

skill_groups.label: Writing
items: rewriting technical material for the public

summary: Former community newspaper correspondent who has worked in public relations for the past year. After five years covering La Union's local government, tourism and surf scene, I now write releases, manage media relations and advise a resort group's management on public statements. I want to grow as a PR officer.

experience.title: Public Relations Officer
experience.employer: San Juan Surf Coast Resorts Group
bullets: Write press releases and handle media enquiries for four resorts and a surf school.
Advise management on statements about beach access and environmental complaints.
Plan the content strategy and posting schedule for the group's social media accounts.

experience.title: Correspondent
bullets: Covered provincial government, tourism and disaster response, filing three to five stories a week.
Edited and proofread other correspondents' stories before print.
Rewrote government advisories into plain-language articles for readers.

education.school: La Union Coastal Institute of Technology
